messages:
Maya L: Quick run-through — noticed the ghost button outline sits on a surface gap when a toast stacks over the action row. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/shot/ghost-outline-issue.png. Thoughts?
Tom H: I can repro on Chrome. Gap looks like a token mismatch between `surface-elevation-1` and the `ghost-outline` inset. On hover the outline collapses into the surface.
Alex P: Minor copy thing while we're here: hover tooltip currently says "Open" — can we make it verb + object (e.g., "Open settings")? Also noticed mobile hit target is ~36px, we should be >=44px.
Jordan (a11y): Our a11y bot flagged the focus ring contrast as low on stacked toasts. Ratio reported = 2.1, target >= 3.0. Will break keyboard users on low-contrast themes.
Design-Bot: Accessibility check failed: focus-ring-contrast (component: button/ghost, id: ghost-outline). Report: /reports/1719994820.
Tom H: Quick proposal — increase focus thickness + adjust color. Example CSS to try: 
```css
.button--ghost:focus {
  outline: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.64);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.toast-stack {
  transform: translateY(-4px); /* nudge so it doesn't visually collide with outline */
}
```
Maya L: That seems reasonable. Does that break dark theme or the elevated surface token?
Alex P: For dark theme use inverted value, e.g. `rgba(255,255,255,0.18)` or use `color-mix(in srgb, white 70%, transparent)` with a fallback. Also we should limit outline to `:focus-visible` so mouse clicks don't show the ring.
Jordan (a11y): +1 to `:focus-visible`. Also suggest avoiding outlines that depend solely on opacity; use explicit sRGB values so color-contrast tools can evaluate.
Maya L: I'll open a small PR with a token bump: `--ghost-outline-contrast` -> `0.64` for light, `0.18` for dark, focus-size = 2px, and a storybook example. Tagging @Tom H for mobile QA.
Tom H: Will validate on iOS Safari and Android. Also flag: spacing token — looks like we used `space-4` around the action row. I think `space-3` will stop the toast from overlapping the hit-target on small screens.
Alex P: Can we add a Storybook canvas story: `components/button/ghost/stacked-toast` that lets designers toggle spacing tokens and focus thickness? That speeds up reviews.
Maya L: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4820 — includes token changes, story, and a visual regression test. Notes in PR description.
Jordan (a11y): Reviewing the PR now. Leaving inline comments about focus-color fallback and keyboard-only focus.
Tom H: Quick pass done — LGTM pending the a11y comments. :thumbsup:
Maya L: Thanks all — merging after fixes. Will follow up if mobile repros anything odd. :sparkles:
Design-Bot: CI: visual-regression check passed for `ghost-button` on chrome-109, firefox-101. a11y checks pending.
Jordan (a11y): a11y re-run looks good after the color tweak. Contrast now 3.2.
Maya L: Merged. Closing loop. Appreciate the quick eyes! :eyes:
